crossRefs.note: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named…
When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,
who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and…
The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down…
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are…
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

translations.web: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
translations.bsb: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.
translations.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
translations.asv: and they rose up, and cast him forth out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might throw him down headlong.
